This is hymn number 220 titled "Lord, I Would Follow Thee" from the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints hymnbook. 
It is written in D Major with a 4/4 time signature. 
The music was composed by K. Newell Dayley and the lyrics were written by Susan Evans McCloud.
